errors.evidence: In the R2 category, the chLSTM bar (light green) has a value closer to -1. Its negative magnitude is visibly smaller than the mBERT bar (light blue) in the same group, which has a value of approximately +2. Stating the value is -2 is a significant overestimation.

In the R4+ category, the chLSTM bar (light green) is only slightly below zero, with a value closer to -0.5. Its negative magnitude is much smaller than other bars with a magnitude of 1 (e.g., the mBERT bar at L3). Stating the value is -1 is an overestimation.
